outcome: complicated perinatal outcome (stillbirth or live neonate requiring admission to neonatal nursery)
cohort: The study included teenagers aged 10-19 years who delivered at a regional hospital in South Africa over a 6-month period in 2018.
finding: Lack of antenatal care, maternal complications, and emergency caesarean section in teenagers were associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including stillbirth and low birthweight.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was associated with complicated perinatal outcomes.
